_about: Preview card text for every topic page, rendered by scripts/build_topic_og.py into docs/og/topics/<slug>-<hash>.png. question: the debate in plain words, no dashes, about 9 words or fewer. positions: short names of the page's debate card positions, in page order (count must match the page). deck: used instead of positions on pages with no debate card. og_description: optional override of the page's meta description for og:description and twitter:description. Edit, then run the script.
